sources.title: What the self-improvement branch built after the research run weighed it, run again with the searches for what is still missing

claims.where: bun run oracle: the solver and plain code agree on all 720 cases

says.lion: a solver's answers checked against plain code

claims.where: bun run affected --replay 30, reading each change by the functions it touches
claims.quote: Median over 30 commits: 41% of the tests' time, 141 of 689 mutations.

claims.where: bun run capability --graded: the agents' run of the corpus, graded by its tasks' checks
claims.quote: Capability: public by sonnet agents tasks, graded by the programs sonnet agents wrote

says.lion: agents' attempts at each task, graded by running checks

claims.where: the agents' failed tries, counted by the cause rules of agent-errors.json

says.lion: failures counted by cause, to choose what to fix

claims.where: the lines of the metrics that log each check the commit hook runs to out/telemetry.jsonl
claims.quote: lines that log a check: 2 lines

says.lion: the outcome and time of every check run, kept as data
